nav.tableRemoteDescription: Remote source with async filter options.
nav.spreadsheetDescription: Async context, dynamic columns, and reference reconciliation.

layout.brandDescription: A restrained sandbox for validating package behavior, visual polish, and theme decisions without losing focus.
layout.sessionDescription: Use these pages to isolate interactions, compare states, and iterate without touching package internals yet.
layout.controlsDescription: Switch locale, tune palette, and adjust shell density directly from the playground.

home.title: Playground Landing
home.description: Start from an empty home state, then open the specific playground surface you want to inspect. This keeps the playground calm by default and makes intent explicit before loading a heavy runtime.

form.title: Form playground
form.description: Schema-driven form runtime with inline, modal, drawer, responsive overlays, live state, and typed submit output.

spreadsheet.title: Spreadsheet playground
spreadsheet.description: Focused import-engine scenarios with isolated fullscreen routes for matching, references, and stress cases.

remoteTable.title: Remote table
remoteTable.description: Server-driven data list playground for remote queries, filters, and table orchestration.

clientTable.title: Client table
clientTable.description: Client-side table playground for local data behavior, filtering, and interaction states.

spreadsheetIndex.title: Spreadsheet playgrounds
spreadsheetIndex.description: Open the route that matches the behavior you want to inspect.

v1Assessments.title: ExAssess V1 assessment import
v1Assessments.description: The ready-made wizard with a step of your own: title rows, renamed and missing columns, unknown values, stored records re-synced.

onePage.title: One page, no steps
onePage.description: Parts placed on a single page: dropzone, mapping only when needed, table, import button.

optionsLab.title: Option sources
optionsLab.description: A list, a TanStack query, a remote loader matched exactly with resolveLabels, value creation, and a select reading another column.

identityLab.title: Row identity
identityLab.description: Duplicates in the file and stored records: error, keep first or last, update, skip, or decide per row.

largeFile.title: Large file
largeFile.description: 5,000 rows past a 4,800 row limit, with the grid virtualized.

v1Assessments.title: Import assessments
v1Assessments.trySample: No file at hand? Try a sample

onePage.title: Import rates
onePage.description: From our own template: the mapping and the values appear only when something needs an answer.

overview.title: A focused playground shell for iterating on the toolkit.
overview.description: Keep structure, theme testing, and page-level experiments here while the package APIs are rebuilt from a clean baseline.

spreadsheet.title: Full workflow playground for the spreadsheet import runtime.
spreadsheet.description: This page exercises workbook parsing, dynamic affiliation columns, row parsing, and exam-to-product reconciliation on top of the new headless spreadsheet session.
spreadsheet.note: Switching the test center rebuilds the schema factory so the runtime reflects a different remote context and a different target payload shape.

form.title: Form surface is intentionally empty for now.
form.description: Use this page to prototype schemas, validation flows, and field rendering when package work begins.
form.note: Keep the shell quiet here so validation states and field composition are easy to inspect.

table.title: V2 table progress board and preview surface.
table.description: This route now tracks the live Data Table V2 implementation and should stay updated as schema, engine, and UI capabilities land.
table.note: Use this page as the broadest currently-working preview rather than keeping progress trapped inside package internals.
table.metaDescription: The preview currently exercises the schema builder, the typed table API, and the debug snapshot surface.
table.schemaDescription: Builder callbacks are resolved into concrete columns and filters here so the playground reflects the same structure future runtime steps will consume.
table.featureDescription: This schema intentionally touches views, layouts, filters, context, page context, actions, controls, and persistence so regression risk is visible early.
table.debugDescription: Until rows and async orchestration are implemented, the debug panel shows the current API snapshot and normalized schema metadata.

lab.title: Scratch space for rough ideas and temporary UI.
lab.description: Use the lab when you want to try interactions quickly without committing them to a dedicated package page yet.
lab.note: Use the controls popover to live edit palette, density, and locale while testing one-off interactions here.

formPage.title: Workspace
formPage.description: Every text on this page is translated: switch the language to see it follow.
